## Browse by Special


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

base_dir <- "."

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find all immediate top-level folders
# ------------------------------------------------------------

md_dirs <- list.dirs(
  base_dir,
  recursive = FALSE,
  full.names = FALSE
)

md_dirs <- md_dirs[!grepl("^\\.", md_dirs)]

md_dirs <- md_dirs[
  !md_dirs %in% c(
    "index_files",
    "_site",
    "_freeze",
    ".quarto",
    "Images",
    "images"
  )
]

md_dirs <- sort(md_dirs)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Encode relative URLs while preserving folder separators
# ------------------------------------------------------------

clean_web_path <- function(path) {

  path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", path)

  # Remove leading ./ because it can cause problems in rendered pages
  path <- sub("^\\./", "", path)

  # Encode spaces only, while preserving /
  path <- gsub(" ", "%20", path, fixed = TRUE)

  path
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find docs folder regardless of capitalisation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

find_docs_dir <- function(md, base_dir = ".") {

  md_path <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    md
  )

  if (!dir.exists(md_path)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  child_dirs <- list.dirs(
    md_path,
    recursive = FALSE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  docs_match <- child_dirs[
    tolower(basename(child_dirs)) == "docs"
  ]

  if (!length(docs_match)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  docs_match[1]
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find the dashboard HTML
#
# Normal folders:
# Folder Name/docs/page.html
#
# Match Previews:
# Match Previews/index.html
# ------------------------------------------------------------

find_dashboard_html <- function(md, base_dir = ".") {

  md_path <- file.path(
    base_dir,
    md
  )

  if (!dir.exists(md_path)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }


  # Special case: Match Previews links directly to its index
  if (tolower(trimws(md)) == "match previews") {

    preview_index <- file.path(
      md_path,
      "index.html"
    )

    if (file.exists(preview_index)) {
      return(preview_index)
    }

    return(NA_character_)
  }


  # Standard folders use a docs directory
  docs_dir <- find_docs_dir(
    md,
    base_dir
  )

  if (is.na(docs_dir)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  html_files <- list.files(
    docs_dir,
    pattern = "\\.html$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (!length(html_files)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }


  # Prefer index.html if present
  index_file <- html_files[
    tolower(basename(html_files)) == "index.html"
  ]

  if (length(index_file)) {
    return(index_file[1])
  }


  # Otherwise use first HTML file alphabetically
  sort(html_files)[1]
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find thumbnail
# ------------------------------------------------------------

default_thumb <- "Images/Premier-league-ball.png"
fallback_thumb <- "Images/champions-league-ball.png"


pick_md_thumb <- function(md, base_dir = ".") {

  # Match Previews uses the fixed Premier League image
  if (tolower(trimws(md)) == "match previews") {
    return(default_thumb)
  }

  docs_dir <- find_docs_dir(
    md,
    base_dir
  )

  if (is.na(docs_dir) || !dir.exists(docs_dir)) {
    return(fallback_thumb)
  }

  # Search recursively for all suitable image files
  image_files <- list.files(
    docs_dir,
    pattern = "\\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp)$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (!length(image_files)) {
    return(fallback_thumb)
  }

  # Find the Match Result Probability plot
  probability_plot <- image_files[
    grepl(
      "Match[ _-]*Result[ _-]*Probab.*lity[ _-]*Plot",
      basename(image_files),
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  if (!length(probability_plot)) {
    return(fallback_thumb)
  }

  # Convert the located filesystem path into a relative website path
  relative_inside_docs <- substring(
    probability_plot[1],
    nchar(docs_dir) + 2
  )

  relative_path <- file.path(
    md,
    basename(docs_dir),
    relative_inside_docs
  )

  gsub("\\\\", "/", relative_path)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract a subtitle from the HTML
# ------------------------------------------------------------

extract_subtitle <- function(html_path) {

  x <- tryCatch(
    readLines(
      html_path,
      warn = FALSE,
      encoding = "UTF-8"
    ),
    error = function(e) character(0)
  )

  if (!length(x)) {
    return("Open dashboard")
  }

  txt <- paste(
    x,
    collapse = "\n"
  )


  # Try the HTML title
  m <- regexpr(
    "(?is)<title>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</title>",
    txt,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  if (m[1] != -1) {

    title <- sub(
      "(?is).*<title>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</title>.*",
      "\\1",
      regmatches(txt, m),
      perl = TRUE
    )

    title <- gsub(
      "\\s*\\|\\s*.*$",
      "",
      title
    )

    title <- gsub(
      "\\s*-\\s*Quarto$",
      "",
      title
    )

    title <- trimws(title)

    if (nzchar(title)) {
      return(title)
    }
  }


  # Fallback to first H1
  m2 <- regexpr(
    "(?is)<h1[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</h1>",
    txt,
    perl = TRUE
  )

  if (m2[1] != -1) {

    h1 <- sub(
      "(?is).*<h1[^>]*>\\s*([^<]+?)\\s*</h1>.*",
      "\\1",
      regmatches(txt, m2),
      perl = TRUE
    )

    h1 <- trimws(h1)

    if (nzchar(h1)) {
      return(h1)
    }
  }


  if (
    grepl(
      "Match Previews",
      html_path,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ) {
    return("Open Premier League match previews")
  }

  "Open dashboard"
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Build dashboard cards
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cards <- vapply(
  md_dirs,
  function(md) {

    full_html_path <- find_dashboard_html(
      md,
      base_dir
    )

    if (is.na(full_html_path)) {
      return(NA_character_)
    }


    # Build relative link
    if (tolower(trimws(md)) == "match previews") {

      rel_path <- file.path(
        md,
        "index.html"
      )

    } else {

      docs_dir <- find_docs_dir(
        md,
        base_dir
      )

      rel_path <- file.path(
        md,
        basename(docs_dir),
        basename(full_html_path)
      )
    }

    rel_path <- gsub(
      "\\\\",
      "/",
      rel_path
    )
    
    # Get thumbnail
    thumb <- pick_md_thumb(
      md,
      base_dir
    )
    
    thumb_url <- clean_web_path(
  thumb
  )
        
   # Build dashboard URL
    url <- clean_web_path(
  rel_path
  )

    # Get subtitle
    subtitle <- extract_subtitle(
      full_html_path
    )


    # Build card
    sprintf(
      paste0(
        '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-4">\n',
        '  <div class="card season-card">\n',
        '    <div class="season-card-media">\n',
        '      <img src="%s" class="card-img-top img-fluid" alt="%s thumbnail">\n',
        '    </div>\n',
        '    <div class="card-body">\n',
        '      <h3><a href="%s">%s</a></h3>\n',
        '      <div class="text-muted">%s</div>\n',
        '    </div>\n',
        '  </div>\n',
        '</div>\n'
      ),
      thumb_url,
      htmltools::htmlEscape(md),
      url,
      htmltools::htmlEscape(md),
      htmltools::htmlEscape(subtitle)
    )

  },
  character(1)
)


# Remove folders without a valid page
cards <- cards[
  !is.na(cards)
]


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output dashboard grid
# ------------------------------------------------------------

output <- paste0(
  '<div class="grid">\n',
  paste(
    cards,
    collapse = "\n"
  ),
  "\n</div>\n"
)

knitr::asis_output(output)
```
